newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore CPI rises 1.9 pct in January yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Singapore CPI rises 1.9 pct in January yr-on-yr.

text.p: Singapore's consumer price index (CPI) of inflation was up 1.9 percent in January from the same month last year and up 0.2 percent over December 1996, the Department of Statistics said on Sunday.
A Reuters poll of 17 economists last week forecast the CPI had risen 2.0 percent in January from a year earlier.
In December, the CPI rose 2.0 percent from a year ago and 0.2 percent from November.

Note - In January, year-on-year food costs rose 2.7 percent, clothing rose 0.9 percent, housing 1.3 percent, transport and communications 2.5 percent, education and stationery 1.6 percent, health 2.3 percent and miscellaneous costs by 1.2 percent.
